translated_title: With 20 Complaints, Mexico Maintains Defense of 17 Migrants Who Died in the US: SRE
original_title: Con 20 denuncias, México mantiene defensa de 17 migrantes fallecidos en EU: SRE
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: Foreign Secretary Roberto Velasco says Mexico has filed 20 complaints with US authorities over 17 nationals who died in ICE custody or operations, pressing legal and human-rights channels.
